info.name: Workday Security Workday Audit and Compliance Account Signons User Accounts API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

params.name: search
params.description: Search term to filter user accounts by username or display name

items.docs: Retrieve a collection of Workday user accounts including their account status, associated worker, and security configuration. Supports filtering by account status and search terms.

info.name: Workday Security Get a specific user account

params.name: accountId
params.description: Unique identifier of the user account

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Workday user account including account status, associated security groups, and last signon information.
